LESSON: MOSAIC MAKING TECHNIQUES

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 3.1: Mosaic MAKING TECHNIQUES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Mosaic MAKING TECHNIQUES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify locally available materials for making mosaic pictorials for fun.
2. create a simple pictorial using paper cuts for enjoyment.
3. appreciate the sue of locally available materials in creating pictorials 84

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify locally available materials for making mosaic pictorials for fun.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify locally available materials for making mosaic pictorials for fun. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. create a simple pictorial using paper cuts for enjoyment.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to create a simple pictorial using paper cuts for enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the sue of locally available materials in creating pictorials 84
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the sue of locally available materials in creating pictorials 84. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
